name: Beacon
notes: Requires a pyramid of Iron, Gold, Diamond, or Netherite blocks to activate.

name: Netherite Ingot
notes: Shapeless recipe. Combine 4 Netherite Scraps + 4 Gold Ingots.

name: Eye of Ender
notes: Shapeless. Used to locate and activate End Portals in Strongholds.

name: Enchanting Table
notes: Place 15 Bookshelves around it with a 1-block air gap for maximum Level 30 enchantments.

name: Anvil
notes: Used to repair, combine enchantments, and rename gear using XP levels.

name: Brewing Stand
notes: Requires Blaze Powder in the top-left fuel slot to operate.

name: Piston
notes: Combine with a Slimeball in a crafting grid to make a Sticky Piston.

name: Shield
notes: Blocks 100% of melee and projectile damage when held up with Right Click.
